title.suggested: Allen Fails to Appear for Elliott Match

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported from Chicago that Tom Allen failed to appear at Parson Davies' place to put up the preliminary forfeit for a championship prize fight with James Elliott, though Elliott and his backers were there.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Tuesday Morning, December 12, 1882, page 3. Dateline Chicago, Dec. 11

facts.fact: Allen failed to appear at Parson Davies' place in Chicago to put up the preliminary forfeit for a championship prize fight with James Elliott; Elliott and his backers were present
